free_text: A repeat biopsy is indicated due to the high-risk PI-RADS 5 lesion and the rising PSA trend from 1.2 ng/mL to 5.5 ng/mL. Although the prior biopsy grade was not documented, the combination of a high-risk MRI finding and rising PSA trajectory supports further investigation. The evidence converged on the need for a new biopsy to clarify the disease status.
